_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Missile Defense Agency (MDA) Systems Engineering Technical Review (SETR) Package
summary: The Systems Engineering Technical Review (SETR) Package is used by the Government to determine if the emerging system has demonstrated sufficient maturity to enter the next phase of development.
use_relationship:
The Systems Engineering Technical Review (SETR) Package is used by the Government to determine if the emerging system has demonstrated sufficient maturity to enter the next phase of development.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.  This DID is applicable to all Department of Defense (DoD) acquisition programs through all program lifecycle phases.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

children.title: MDA Instruction 5000.20-INS
children.content: "Engineering Technical Review Process," available as a Government Furnished Information (GFI). This Missile Defense Agency (MDA) Instruction provides detailed processes as it applies to Engineering Technical Reviews. This instruction is available via request to MDA/DS, 5700 18th Street, Building 245, Fort Belvoir, VA 22060-5573

children.title: The deliverable shall be in the format
children.content: prescribed in the contract and in accordance with MDA Instruction 5000.20-INS.

children.title: Enclosure 6 - Objective Evidence Matrix Template
children.content: IAW MDA Instruction 5000.20-INS, shall dictate objective Evidence format.

children.title: Delivery format can also be in the form
children.content: of a digital model(s) or as a part of a larger digital model that also encompasses other systems.  When delivered as a digital system model the format shall be in the native model and/or standard-defined data format(s) as specified in the contract statement of work.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The SETR Package that is required in the contract's SOW tasking and delivered per the CDRL shall contain the data that supports the entrance and exit criteria IAW MDA Instruction 5000.20-INS:

children.title: The SETR Package that is required for delivery
children.content: prior to the System Requirements Review (SRR) shall contain content that supports the SRR entrance and exit criteria.

children.title: The SETR Package that is required for delivery
children.content: prior to the System Preliminary Design Review (PDR) shall contain content that supports the PDR entrance and exit criteria.

children.title: The SETR Package that is required for delivery
children.content: prior to the System Critical Design Review (CDR) shall contain content that supports the CDR entrance and exit criteria.

children.title: The SETR Package that is required for delivery
children.content: prior to the System Final Design Review (FDR) shall contain content that addresses the health of the system design in response to the deficiencies noted in the System CDR.

children.title: The SETR Package required for delivery prior to
children.content: any Technical Review shall contain content that addresses the health of the system, entry and exit criteria for that technical review, results of previous technical activities since the last technical review (e.g., studies, analyses), product updates, and other pertinent information.
